name: when-present-walks-into-its-path
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Kinds and Residue: when 7 present holds on the map at 7; the fields lat and lon walk into it (ruling 15: the when does not), so the unmapped member 7.9 is residue and goes back into the map at 7. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
